card.name: Units of measure ending a quantity
card.fires_on: The unit noun that closes a quantity phrase, such as tsp in a dose table or week after "per". Also fires on a few nouns after numbers, like people or women in rate counts.

modes.label: Teaspoon in dose tables
modes.description: The abbreviation tsp inside parentheses after a fraction or number, next to an mL amount.

modes.label: Time unit after per
modes.description: The word week right after "per" in a frequency phrase.

modes.label: Noun after a count
modes.description: A plain noun such as people or women that follows a large number or rate base.
